declared: 2026-10-31, before any model run on these regions (only their grids and WorldClim coverage were built: algeria_sahara 256, sahel_niger 256, najd_arabia 251, mongolia 256, bengal 206, deccan 232 scored land cells at 56 km)
why: The first 31-October sealed set (calibration/sealed_20261031) was run once (dry-heating refit, S 1.0405) and its result (cold steppes warmed, cold coasts made more continental) informs the next dry-heating design, so it is development data from now on.
chosen_for: six climates no earlier scored box covers: hot deserts (Algerian Sahara, Najd), hot semi-arid monsoon edge (Sahel), cold steppe and desert (Mongolia), humid monsoon (Bengal), tropical dry plateau (Deccan); none overlaps the scored box of any of the 43 earlier regions
rules: Never tuned on and never used to design a mechanism. Run once per candidate that has passed the development gate and the 28 km check, paired against the adopted profile; adoption requires them not to get worse (S <= 1). Every result is reported.
